frame.saved: Your progress is saved as you go.

steps.teacher: First {term, select, coach {coach} instructor {instructor} trainer {trainer} other {teacher}}

legal.title: Before you start
legal.body: Please read and accept AcademyBee's terms for {academy}. You only do this once, and again if they change.
legal.updatedBody: Please read and accept the updated terms to keep using AcademyBee.
legal.agree: I have read and accept these documents for {academy}.
legal.mustAgree: Tick the box to accept the documents.

welcome.title: Welcome to {academy}
welcome.body: This is your academy's own workspace. A short guided setup gets your first {course}, {teacher}, {batch} and students ready.
welcome.time: About 10 minutes. You can stop at any time and continue later, on any device.

profile.title: Your academy
profile.body: How your academy appears to staff and parents. You can change this later in Settings.
profile.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB.

type.title: What do you teach?
type.body: This sets the words your academy sees, like Class or Batch. You can change them later.

course.title: Your first {term, select, program {program} other {course}}
course.body: What you teach, for example “Bharatanatyam”, “Class 10 Maths” or “Guitar — beginners”. Add more later.
course.name: Name

teacher.title: Who teaches it?
teacher.body: The person who takes this {batch}. You can add more people later in Team.
teacher.name: Their name
teacher.inviteHint: We'll email them an invitation to join {academy}.
teacher.pending: Invitation sent to {email}. They can join any time in the next 7 days.

batch.title: Your first {term, select, class {class} group {group} other {batch}}
batch.body: A group of students who meet together, for example “Evening juniors”.
batch.name: Name

students.title: Add your first students
students.body: Just names for now, with a parent's mobile number if you have it. Add up to 20 here; you can import the rest later.
students.name: Student's name
students.max: You can add up to 20 students here.
students.limit: Your plan's student limit is reached. Remove some students or change your plan.

timetable.title: When does it meet?
timetable.body: Add the weekly times. We'll create the next two weeks of classes for you.
timetable.endAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.

ready.title: {academy} is ready
ready.body: Here's what you set up. You can change any of it later.
ready.notYet: Finish the academy profile and type first.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a 10-digit Indian mobile number, or a number with its country code.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
errors.needsCourse: Add the first course before this step, or skip it.
errors.needsBatch: Add the first batch before this step, or skip it.
errors.versionConflict: This setup was changed on another device. We've loaded the latest version.
errors.alreadyMember: That person is already part of {academy}.
errors.offline: You're offline. Setup needs a connection.
errors.generic: That didn't save. Try again; if it keeps failing, reload the page.
